page_title: NIC 1-0 HAV | Nice v Le Havre 10/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Benoit Bastien has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
90+1' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Oussama Targhalline is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
82' Here is a change. Etienne Youte Kinkoue is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mohamed-Ali Cho as he is replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
75' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) replaces Pablo Rosario.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morgan Sanson departs the field of play to be replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
75' Wasted effort! Morgan Sanson (Nice) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
72' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Yassine Kechta will be replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
72' Josue Casimir goes off the pitch and Loic Nego (Le Havre) comes on.
67' Morgan Sanson (Nice) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
66' Jeremie Boga (Nice) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Arthur Desmas easily makes the save.
65' Today's referee Benoit Bastien rightly decides to book Melvin Bard (Nice) for his harsh tackle.
63' Benoit Bastien couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Khephren Thuram (Nice) and blew his whistle. Le Havre win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Evann Guessand (Nice) coming on for Terem Moffi.
59' Antoine Mendy is being substituted because of an injury. Francesco Farioli sends Jordan Lotomba (Nice) on the pitch.
59' That will be all from Emmanuel Sabbi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).
56' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.

52' Terem Moffi (Nice) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the left-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Arthur Desmas with a fabulous save.
52' Morgan Sanson (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
51' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
51' Jeremie Boga (Nice) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Nice win a corner.
50' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Marcin Bulka is equal to it.
49' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Le Havre.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+4' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
45+4' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45+2' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
45+2' Melvin Bard (Nice) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Arthur Desmas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
45+1' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
40' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
38' A goal, which was scored by Khephren Thuram (Nice), was disallowed due to offside.
36' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
33' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

33' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul.
32' Jeremie Boga (Nice) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
27' Dante (Nice) brings an opponent down and Benoit Bastien interrupts the game. Le Havre have a free kick.
25' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
19' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) is flagged for offside.
16' A yellow card for a tackle by Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice). Benoit Bastien doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
12' 1 - 0 Jeremie Boga (Nice) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
11' The corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared away by the defence.
10' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' The game is interrupted now, Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
6' Khephren Thuram (Nice) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
6' Jeremie Boga (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

5' Melvin Bard (Nice) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nice will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien is introduced as the referee for today's match.
